## 1. Executive Summary

The end-to-end (E2E) testing suite for **PyThaiTrace v2.0** has been fully authored, verified for collection integrity, and documented across 59 automated test cases and 17 test fixtures.

The test suite strictly adheres to the 4-Tier testing methodology defined in `TEST_INFRA.md`, validating CLI argument passthrough, compile-time syntax checking, thread safety, 3-tier exception matching, universal fallback for 3rd-party libraries, and responsive terminal rendering across 35 to 200 column displays.

---

## 2. Test Execution Commands

```powershell
# Run the entire test suite
python -m pytest tests -v

# Run individual test modules
python -m pytest tests/test_runner.py -v
python -m pytest tests/test_matcher.py -v
python -m pytest tests/test_responsive.py -v

# Run test collection check
python -m pytest --collect-only tests/

# Run with test coverage report
python -m pytest tests --cov=pythaitrace --cov-report=term-missing
```

## 5. Feature & Contract Verification Checklist

- [x] **CLI Entrypoint & Passthrough**: `clean_script.py` and `clean_script_with_args.py` verify transparent execution.
- [x] **Exit Code Fidelity**: Verifies 0 on success, 1 on unhandled exception, and preserves explicit `sys.exit(N)` codes.
- [x] **Pre-execution Compilation Check**: Verifies compile check intercepts `SyntaxError` and `IndentationError` before runtime code executes.
- [x] **Exception Hooks**: Verifies `sys.excepthook` and `threading.excepthook` capture uncaught main and worker thread errors.
- [x] **Original English Traceback**: Verifies standard CPython traceback remains intact on `sys.stderr`.
- [x] **3-Tier Matcher Cascade**: Verifies Tier 1 (regex with named groups), Tier 2 (fuzzy tokens), and Tier 3 (class generic).
- [x] **Universal `__FALLBACK__`**: Verifies 3rd-party/unmapped exceptions extract module name, class name, docstring, and valid search URLs.
- [x] **Responsive Dual-Mode Renderer**:
  - [x] Wide Mode (>= 80 cols) verified at 80 and 120 columns with panel borders and syntax snippet.
  - [x] Narrow Mode (< 80 cols) verified at 60 and 45 columns with flat layout, left-accent bar `▌`, and zero line truncation.
  - [x] Dynamic breakpoint switch verified at 79 vs 80 columns.
- [x] **Thai & Emoji Typography**: Verifies Unicode cell lengths (`cell_len`) with combining tone marks and emojis.
- [x] **Zero-Crash Failsafe Shield**: Verifies internal exception in matcher or renderer falls back safely and never crashes user process.
